name: Just Breathe Normally (The Lumen Skin Recall Face)
creator: Axiom Network One (source); viral remixers across all tiers
description: In 2198, during the live neural-feed launch event for Axiom's Lumen Skin cosmetic geneware line, brand ambassador Celestine Oduya-Marchetti was mid-sentence when her newly installed sample product visibly desynchronized — her face cycling through six preset 'radiance expressions' in 0.4 seconds before locking into a wide-eyed rictus grin the company called 'Luminous Confidence.' The original feed clip, which Axiom pulled within eleven minutes, had already been cached and remixed approximately 340,000 times. The phrase 'just breathe normally' comes from the off-feed whisper of a handler audible in the source clip, now used universally to mean 'pretend the catastrophic malfunction isn't happening.'
medium: neural feed clip (originally broadcast, now pirate-cached); audio sample; holographic reaction loop
cultural_impact: Became the definitive shorthand for corporate product failure and institutional gaslighting; the six-expression sequence is still reproduced in protest art and comedy feeds nearly two decades later.
controversy: Axiom pursued seventeen cache-hosts under proprietary feed content law; all seventeen were acquitted under the Meridian Satire Precedent of 2199, which effectively enshrined meme-remixing of corporate broadcasts as protected expression.
story_hooks: A player character needs to access the original uncut 11-minute feed — not the clip, but everything that happened before and after — which Axiom has buried but not destroyed.
Celestine Oduya-Marchetti, now living under a different name on Tier 2, has a reason to want the clip permanently erased and will pay significantly for it.
A new Axiom geneware product is launching and someone has discovered the same desync flaw; they must decide whether to warn the public or sell the information back to Axiom.
